auto — выбор по содержимому PDF.\n\n+ Те:
auto — choose based on PDF content.

+ Text PDFs: Structured, or PyMuPDF if unavailable. Pages containing scans: Marker, when installed.
− This is a heuristic: check complex tables. Scans cannot be read without Marker.
marker — нейросети: анализ вёрстки, OCR,:
marker — neural networks: layout analysis, OCR and table recognition.

+ Handles borderless tables, equations, columns, scans (OCR) and images.
− Slow: often about 1 min/page on CPU; faster on GPU. The first run loads models. Progress is approximate. Check the result: recognition can change numbers or merge tables.

Use for: scans, borderless tables and equations when you can wait.
structured — извлечение текстового слоя:
structured — extract and format the PDF text layer (pymupdf4llm).

+ Fast: seconds for many pages. Headings, lists, emphasis, bordered tables (HTML for merged cells), images in reading order and header removal. Does not invent text.
− Borderless tables become text lines; no OCR for scans; equations become plain text.

Use for: manuals and books with a text layer.
pymupdf — сырой текст постранично.\n\n+:
pymupdf — plain text, page by page.

+ Fast and predictable: extracts the text layer with few dependencies.
− No headings, tables or images; columns may mix; scans have no text.

Use for: text search, comparison or when other engines fail.
